I won’t sit out on the patio at dusk in the summer because that’s when they come out. On book tours, I’ve even asked to change hotel rooms after noticing a spider in the corner.

I understand they’re just ordinary spiders; I don’t think they’re talking to me or controlled by anyone. I know it’s irrational and overblown, but the fear itself feels very real in the moment, so I do everything I can to avoid any chance of running into one.
